blocks.text: Zscaler Microsegmentation APIs enable customers and partners to visualize and manage workload traffic flows within private applications, apply fine-grained segmentation, and query operational telemetry. The platform uses the Zscaler cloud and deployed agents to collect application flow data, enforce identity-based access policies, and monitor agent and system health.
To authenticate and make calls to the Microsegmentation API, you must complete the following steps:

blocks.item: Ensure that all prerequisites are met.
Download the GraphQL Schema in Postman and use it to make API calls.
